t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Certain pairs of gnomes appear together and after a few rounds it will become clear which gnomes yield more mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: In the game, gnomes appear in pairs. Red vs green, pink vs orange, etc. The gnome you choose will determine the amount of mushroom you will be able to collect. After a few rounds it is easy to figure out which ones are more valuable to you, but be aware, after a certain number of rounds the combinations change, so if the high earning gnome was blue before, it will now be yellow. I have also found that reaction times are also correlated with how many mushrooms you get when picking your gnomes. If you react to picking any gnome later, there may be more reward, and vice versa.
